diagnosed_problem: Frontend hangs and returns HTTP 500 when currencyservice is paused because gRPC calls have no per-call deadline and currency data is treated as fatal.

evidence.interpretation: High error rate caused by frontend hanging on currencyservice pause.

edits.replacement:
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 1*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	currs, err := pb.NewCurrencyServiceClient(fe.currencySvcConn).
		GetSupportedCurrencies(ctx, &pb.Empty{})
edits.purpose: Add a per-call deadline to prevent indefinite hangs when currencyservice is paused.

edits.original:
return pb.NewCurrencyServiceClient(fe.currencySvcConn).
		Convert(ctx, &pb.CurrencyConversionRequest{
			From:   money,
			ToCode: currency})
edits.replacement:
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 1*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	return pb.NewCurrencyServiceClient(fe.currencySvcConn).
		Convert(ctx, &pb.CurrencyConversionRequest{
			From:   money,
			ToCode: currency})
edits.purpose: Add a per-call deadline to the currency conversion RPC to avoid hanging calls.
Treat missing currency data as optional on Home page, logging the error and rendering without it.
Make currency list optional on Product page, avoiding fatal errors when currencyservice is down.
Fall back to original price if currency conversion fails, preventing page crashes.

expected_benefit: Pages will continue to render even when currencyservice is paused, reducing error rate and latency dramatically.
side_effects: Pages may show no currency selector and prices in default currency when currencyservice is unavailable.
author: llm:openai/gpt-oss-120b

build.detail: gofmt and go build succeeded in golang:1.27.0-alpine

critique: review: src/frontend/rpc.go:getCurrencies – the added 100 ms timeout is too aggressive and will turn normal, healthy calls into failures; use a longer timeout (e.g., 1 s) or make it configurable so the success path isn’t altered.
review: src/frontend/rpc.go:convertCurrency – same overly‑short 100 ms deadline; increase it to a safe value or make it configurable.
review: src/frontend/rpc.go – missing import for the "time" package after adding context.WithTimeout calls; add "time" to the import list.
